purpose: Local-only diagnostic of 16 E40 declared result markers against two existing Phase2 attempt metadata manifests. No new remote read or source/result/log file opening.
execution: python -m scripts.run_ranking_v6_e41_local_join, no dynamic arguments; exactly one gated local read, zero retries
reader_policy: Existing stable descriptor/ancestor/single-link/SHA reader, exact manifest schema and per-circuit TRAIN family. CSV bytes decode to generic strings for selection, but wall/status strings are not analyzed, evaluated, compared, returned or used to select attempts. All 6985 rows selected.
marker_rule: Historical src/data/audit_runtime_action_attempt_mapping_v1.py basename(): last path component and strip exactly one matching suffix in order .driver.log/.log/.tsv/.csv. Only reproduce pure textual rule; never run/import historical quality mapper.
strict_scope: Exact circuit+mode+marker; declared path lexically under its pinned coverage root/04_integer_refine; relative attempt path's first component exact coverage leaf, second component and metadata stage both 04_integer_refine. No resolving, realpath, following paths, fuzzy/global-basename choice or cross-stage fallback.
retention: Count zero/one/multiple strict matches for each scoped source+mode declaration. Separately retain same-namespace stage conflicts, other-namespace and other-circuit/mode marker collisions; keep shared references. No automatic source-version or physical-call assignment, cost synthesis or data release.
gate: Focused synthetic tests, independent source/semantic review and pre-call permission gate before one actual local execution. Errors produce fixed code, no raw rows/paths or partial successful result.
publication: Git receives small counts/declaration marker and strict attempt-ID hashes, not raw paths, attempt records, result files or wall values.
